title: Production Outage Alert
description: A monitoring alert just came in reporting the production system is down for some customers. Decide how to respond.
instructions: Read the incoming request, then choose the single best response action.

metadata.subject: ALERT: Production outage affecting customers
metadata.message: Our production system has been returning errors for the last 4 minutes. Customer support is already receiving complaints. This is affecting live transactions.

options.label: Immediately escalate to the on-call incident response team
Try to fix it yourself before telling anyone
Forward the alert to a junior teammate and move on
Wait until the next scheduled check-in to look into it

title: Executive Asks for an Urgent Number
description: A senior executive needs a specific figure before a meeting that starts in 10 minutes. Decide how to respond.
instructions: Read the incoming request, then choose the single best response action.

metadata.subject: Need Q3 churn number before my 10am
metadata.message: I'm walking into a board meeting in 10 minutes and need the exact Q3 customer churn rate. Can you get this to me right now?

options.label: Pull the number immediately yourself and reply right away
Forward the request up the chain to your own manager
Assign it to someone else and check back later
Reply that you'll get to it after your current task
Ask her to clarify which churn definition she means before doing anything
